rows.en: We are. Big sister is cooking.
I am busy. You go ahead and eat.

rows.zh: 她说她忙. 别忘了她的饺子!
rows.en: She says she is busy. Do not forget her dumplings!

你: A person: the one you are talking to.
们: It turns one person into several: 你们 is all of you.
做: Making and doing are what people do.

traps.谁: The middle of 谁 looks like 亻, but it belongs to the right-hand part. 谁 carries 讠 SPEECH.

好: A woman with a child 子: the old picture of something good.
奶: 奶奶 is grandma, your father's mother.
她: 他 with the person swapped for a woman.

谁: A question you ask. You will hear both shéi and shuí.

想: Wanting happens in the heart. Underneath, the radical keeps its full shape 心.
忙: A state of mind. On the left the heart thins to 忄.
快: It first meant glad, as it still does in 快乐, happy.
忘: Lost 亡 from the heart 心.

radNotes.person: 亻 is for people in general. Another of the thirty is narrower: women and family.

builds.posNote: 女 stands on the left and narrows a little to make room.
builds.done: 女 says a woman. 马 mǎ lends its sound: mā.

radNotes.mouth: 口 is for eating and noises. A polite request is made in words.

builds.posNote: 讠 is the thin side form of 言. It always stands on the left.
builds.done: 讠 says it is spoken. 青 qīng lends its sound: qǐng.

builds.posNote: Underneath, the heart keeps its full shape 心. On the left it thins to 忄.
builds.done: 心 says it happens in the heart. 相 xiāng lends its sound: xiǎng.

rows.en: It is nothing serious. Get more sleep.
Drink more water and look at your phone less.
Rub ointment on the foot and change the dressing every day.
Come back tomorrow for an injection.

痒: Not quite pain, but still a complaint.
病: The radical is named after this one.

hunts.hint: It usually stands on the left. Look underneath as well.

胃: An organ of the body. Here 月 sits underneath.
背: A part of the body, again with 月 underneath.
脚: The foot as a part of the body. ⻊ FOOT is kept for what feet do.

traps.睛: There is a small 月 in 睛, at the bottom of its sound part 青. The meaning part is 目 EYE.
traps.明: The 月 in 明 is the moon, beside the sun 日: bright. Same shape, but not the body.

眼: The everyday word is 眼睛, and both halves carry 目.
睛: The second half of 眼睛, eye.
看: A hand 手 shading the eye. Here 目 sits underneath.

按: Pressing is done with the hand. 按时 is keeping to the time.
抹: You rub it on with your hand.
换: Swapping one thing for another, by hand.
打: A hand strikes. 打针 is to give an injection.

traps.看: The top of 看 is a whole hand 手, shading the eye. But 看 is about seeing, so it carries 目 EYE.

builds.posNote: 扌 is the thin side form of 手. It always stands on the left.
builds.done: 扌 says a hand does it. 丁 dīng lends the start of its sound: dǎ.

radNotes.walk: 辶 is about distance and travel. This one is what the feet themselves do.
radNotes.flesh: 月 names parts of the body. Running is something the feet do.

builds.posNote: ⻊ is 足 squeezed onto the left, with its last stroke tilted up.
builds.done: ⻊ says the feet do it. 包 bāo lends its sound: pǎo.

radNotes.flesh: 月 names parts of the body. Being unwell has a radical of its own.

builds.posNote: 疒 covers the top and runs down the left side.
builds.done: 疒 says illness. 丙 bǐng lends its sound: bìng.

rows.en: A big gap between morning and evening temperatures.
Take an umbrella when you go out.

霜: Cold weather settling on the ground.

hunts.hint: Look on the left first, then underneath.

春: The season the sun comes back. Here 日 sits underneath.
明: Sun and moon 月 together. 明天 is tomorrow.

traps.温: There is a 日 in 温, but it sits inside the right-hand part. The meaning part is 氵 WATER.
traps.湿: There is a 日 in 湿, but it sits inside the right-hand part. The meaning part is 氵 WATER.

汉: 汉 began as the name of a river. 武汉 stands where it meets the Yangtze.
温: Warm was first said of water.
滑: A wet road is a slippery one.

traps.冷: 冷 has two drops, not three. 冫 is ICE, a different radical.

radNotes.rain: 雨 is for weather from the sky. Washing uses water on the ground.

builds.posNote: 氵 is the thin side form of 水. It always stands on the left.
builds.done: 氵 says water is involved. 先 xiān lends the start of its sound: xǐ.

radNotes.water: A fair guess, since boiling needs water. This character points at what does the heating.

builds.posNote: Underneath, 火 flattens into four dots, 灬: a fire under the pot.
builds.done: 灬 says fire. 者 zhě lends the start of its sound: zhǔ.

radNotes.water: 氵 is for water you can pour. Fog hangs in the sky.

builds.posNote: 雨 always sits on top, pressed flat, like the sky it falls from.
builds.done: 雨 says weather. 务 wù lends its whole sound: wù.

猫: 熊猫, bear cat, is the giant panda.
狐: 狐狸 is a fox, and both halves carry 犭.
狸: The second half of 狐狸, fox.

hunts.hint: It usually stands on the left. Look underneath as well.

蛇: 虫 began as a drawing of a snake.
蝴: 蝴蝶 is a butterfly, and both halves carry 虫.
蝶: The second half of 蝴蝶.
蛙: Small, damp and hopping: frogs are filed with the bugs.
蜜: Made by insects. Here 虫 sits underneath.

荷: A water plant. 荷花 is its flower.
草: The radical is named after it.

traps.猫: There is a 艹 in 猫, on top of its sound part 苗 miáo. The meaning part is 犭 ANIMAL.

树: The everyday word for a tree.
梅: A fruit tree, loved for its winter blossom.

traps.茶: The bottom of 茶 looks like 木, but tea is a leafy plant: it carries 艹 GRASS.
traps.蝶: There is a 木 in 蝶, at the bottom of its sound part. The meaning part is 虫 BUG.

radNotes.tree: 木 is for trees and things made of wood. Flowers and leafy plants take another one.

builds.done: 艹 says it is a plant. 化 huà lends its sound: huā.

radNotes.bug: 虫 is for insects and small crawling things. A cat has four legs and fur.

builds.posNote: 犭 is the side form of 犬, dog. It always stands on the left.
builds.done: 犭 says an animal. 苗 miáo lends its sound: māo, close to a meow.

radNotes.animal: 犭 is for four-legged animals. This one has six legs and wings.

builds.posNote: 虫 stands on the left here. In a few characters, such as 蜜, it drops to the bottom.
builds.done: 虫 says a bug. 文 wén lends its whole sound: wén.

海: Seafood comes out of the sea.
河: 河粉 is short for Shahe noodles, named after a town whose name means sand river.
沙: Sand lies where water has been. Here 沙拉 only spells out the sound of salad: shālā.
汽: Steam rises off water. 汽水 is gas water.

traps.冰: 冰 has two drops, not three. 冫 is ICE, a different radical.

炒: Tossed in a pan over a flame.
烧: 红烧 is red-braising: cooked slowly over heat.
煎: The fire sits underneath, flattened into 灬.
热: Heat, with the fire underneath as 灬.

饭: The everyday word for a meal.
馒: 馒头 is a plain steamed bun.

radNotes.mouth: 口 marks eating as something you do, as in 吃. The meal itself takes another one.

builds.posNote: 饣 is the thin side form of 食. It always stands on the left.
builds.done: 饣 says food. 反 fǎn lends its sound: fàn.

radNotes.roof: 宀 covers a house from above. This one is what you walk through.

builds.posNote: 门 stands around the outside, and the other part goes in the doorway.
builds.done: Sunlight 日 through the gap in a door: the space between. Both parts carry meaning here, and neither gives the sound.

radNotes.person: A fair guess, since a guest is a person. This character is about being under someone's roof.

builds.posNote: 宀 always sits on top, like the roof it is.
builds.done: 宀 says under a roof. 各 gè lends its ending: kè.

通: A way through is a way you can walk.
道: A road is for walking. 通道 is a passage.
退: Stepping backwards. 退票 hands a ticket back.
运: Moving things from place to place.

轮: What a vehicle rolls on. 轮椅 is a wheelchair.
辆: 一辆车 is one car. 车辆 is vehicles in general.
转: Wheels go round. 转车 is changing trains.
软: First said of a cart with padded wheels, for a gentle ride.

铁: A metal. 地铁, ground iron, is the underground railway.
银: A metal. 银行, silver house, is a bank.
镜: The first mirrors were polished bronze. 眼镜 is glasses.

hunts.hint: Look on the left and underneath.

贵: It costs many shells. 贵宾 is an honoured guest.
费: Shells going out. 免费 is free of charge.

radNotes.foot: ⻊ is for what feet do: run, jump, kick. Distance and travel take another one.

builds.posNote: 辶 always wraps the left side and the bottom.
builds.done: 辶 says it is about movement and distance. 元 yuán lends its sound: yuǎn.

radNotes.sun: 日 marks time, as in 时. This is the thing itself, and it was first cast in bronze.

builds.posNote: 钅 is the thin side form of 金. It always stands on the left.
builds.done: 钅 says metal. 中 zhōng lends its whole sound: zhōng.

radNotes.metal: 钅 gives 钱, money as coins. Trade goes back further, to shells.

builds.posNote: 贝 often sits underneath, as in 贵 and 费. It can also stand on the left, as in 购.
builds.done: 贝 says trade. 化 huà lends its sound: huò, as it did in 花 huā.
